overview.overview:
New Jersey is projected to be one of the more reliably Democratic states in 2028. It voted for the Democratic presidential nominee by about 16 points in 2020 and by roughly 6 points in 2024, a narrowing that still left it well ahead of the national result. Its lean runs well to the Democratic side of the country as a whole, and most national scenarios in the forecast point to a Democratic win here.

No public polling for the state is included in the available information, so the outlook rests on past results and the broader national environment. Cory Booker (D) and Chris Christie (R) are the home-state figures listed. The state's 14 electoral votes are very unlikely to decide the national outcome.
overview.watch: A sustained national shift toward Republicans, or a notable drop in Democratic turnout in New Jersey, would be the most likely developments to change this outlook.
key_factors: Democratic results in 2020 and 2024, with a narrower 2024 margin
A lean well toward Democrats compared with the nation
